description:
Will Satan impersonate Jesus in the last days? Is the Mark of the Beast an actual mark on your forehead? Find out the answers to these questions and more with Pastor James Rafferty and Daniel Perrin, hosted by Jason Bradley.

Send us your Bible Questions! 
By email: BibleQA@3abn.org 
By text: (618) 228-3975

QUESTIONS COVERED:

1. Does Revelation 1:7 mention the second coming or the third coming of Jesus Christ? It talks about the people who pierced him and also that all the earth will wail. Are these the wicked ones who will witness the third coming because during the second coming all the wicked will be dead? 

2. Who is the John that wrote Revelation and can we believe it is accurate? 

3. Can you please explain 1 Corinthians 15:29? 

4.  Does the Bible say that Satan himself will impersonate Jesus in the last days? Will Satan impersonate Jesus in the last days?  

5. Is the Mark of the Beast an actual mark on your forehead? 

6.  Proverbs 12:22 says lying lips are an abomination to the LORD. Why was it acceptable for Rahab to lie? Does this mean it is ok to lie to non- believers? Are there other examples of this happening in the Bible? 

7. What will be the great falling away? Is it to come or has it happened already? 

8.  If the wedges for sin is death, then why after paying those wedges do we still need to be judged whether we will see everlasting destruction or everlasting life? How many times after death will we pay for the same sins? If the wages of sin is death, why will we still be judged? 

9.  Revelation 7: 1-3 states that the four Angels who were at the four corners of the earth, were told not to harm the earth until the servants of God are sealed. At what point does the sealing take place? How can we know that they are sealed? Can you please explain the Revelation 7: 1-3? 

10.  I want so much to read the Bible but I have trouble understanding much of it. Is it okay to read THE CLEAR WORD since it is easier to understand? Is it okay to read The Clear Word?
